series.label: Public pension 5-year return · native plans
series.definition: Native all-employee/all-tier PPD plan observations. Plans are not state averages. Fiscal end dates and fee basis can differ; estimation flags are preserved.
limitations: Long-horizon annualized returns overlap across years, inducing serial dependence.
Historical source-review outliers are retained for inspection but excluded from models by default.
A fund return is not a retiree benefit increase.
